title: Uruguayan-Style Grilled Steak with Kale Salad
description: A classic Uruguayan dish featuring grilled steak served with a simple kale salad.
instructions: Season the flank steak with salt, black pepper, and Uruguayan-style seasoning.
Grill the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, massage the kale with light vinaigrette until slightly tender.
Slice the grilled steak against the grain and serve with the kale salad.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional light olive oil and light vinaigrette if desired.
